papers.title: High-resolution structures of human NHE6 and NHE9 elucidate endosomal ion and lipid interactions
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Endosomal NHE6 (SLC9A6) and NHE9 (SLC9A9) transporters are essential for maintaining pH homeostasis within endosomes and their dysfunction has been linked to neurological and neurodegenerative disorders. NHE6 and NHE9 are widely considered to function as electroneutral exchangers that couple the export of protons to the import of sodium or potassium ions across cellular membranes, thereby forming the basis of proton leak pathways for internal pH balancing and fine-tuning. Among the 13 identified SLC9 family members, only NHE6 and NHE9 are targeted to endosomes. Despite their biological importance and therapeutic potential, the structural basis for their activity and regulation remains elusive. Here, we present the cryo-EM structures of human NHE9 and two splice variants of NHE6 that differ by alternative inclusion of the β-hairpin motif-containing loop domain located between transmembrane helices 2 and 3, showcasing structural diversity within the organellar NHE subfamily. By mapping the sodium-binding site, our results provide mechanistic insights into ion transport, and for NHE6 we provide evidence for a conserved PIP2-mediated regulatory mechanism. These findings provide a framework for understanding endosomal NHE function with implications for disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease and glioblastoma.
papers.summary_ko: 인간 엔도솜 이온교환체 NHE6와 NHE9의 고해상도 냉동전자현미경 구조를 규명했다. 나트륨 결합 부위를 매핑해 양성자-양이온 교환 메커니즘을 밝히고, NHE6에서는 PIP2 매개 조절 기전의 증거를 제시했다. 두 단백질의 스플라이스 변이체 간 구조적 다양성도 확인했다.

papers.title: Intelligent Response and Dynamic Stress Equilibrium Structure Endow Lithium-Rich Oxide Cathodes with Long Cycle Life
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Lithium-rich oxides (LROs) deliver an energy density of over 1000 Wh kg−1 for lithium-ion battery cathode applications, yet cycling-induced stress accumulation triggers structural degradation and poor cyclic stability. Herein, hierarchical twin structures are prefabricated in LROs. Prestress at twin boundaries forms interlaced stress networks to adaptively accommodate tensile/compressive strains upon cycling and dissipate localized stress concentration. The self-adaptive twin structure tolerates cyclic volume fluctuation, preserving the layered framework against irreversible spinel/rock-salt phase transition during long-term structural relaxation. The twin-modified LRO retains 94.98% capacity after 500 cycles (1 C) and 80.79% after 800 cycles, with 155.31 mAh g−1 at 5 C. The pouch cell delivers 12.59 Ah discharge capacity and maintains 84.83% capacity after 49 cycles. This work offers a strategy to tune electrochemo-mechanical properties for designing cathode materials.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 과잉 산화물(LRO) 양극재에 계층적 쌍정 구조를 도입해 사이클링 중 응력을 분산시키는 전략을 제시했다. 쌍정 경계의 프리스트레스가 인장/압축 변형을 완충해 층상 구조의 스피넬/암염상 전이를 억제한다. 개질된 LRO는 500사이클(1C) 후 94.98%, 800사이클 후 80.79%의 용량 유지율을 보였고 5C에서 155.31 mAh g⁻¹을 나타냈으며, 12.59 Ah 파우치셀은 49사이클 후 84.83% 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Decoding Multiscale Degradation of Layered Cathodes in All‐Solid‐State Lithium Batteries: An Advanced Diagnostics‐Driven Framework
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state lithium batteries (ASSLBs) with layered oxide cathodes such as LiNi 1‐x‐y Mn x Co y O 2 (NMC), LiNi 1‐x‐y Co x Al y O 2 (NCA), LiNiO 2 (LNO), and lithium‐rich layered oxides (LLOs) offer superior energy density and safety, yet their performance is severely limited by complex, coupled degradation mechanisms at the cathode/inorganic solid‐state electrolyte (SSE) interface and within the cathode bulk. This review establishes a Diagnosis‐Mechanism‐Mitigation (D‐M‐M) framework that decodes these multiscale degradation phenomena by cross‐validating multimodal diagnostic evidence from electronic structure to the cell level. Two categories are dissected: interfacial degradation, encompassing chemical decomposition, space‐charge layer formation, and resistive interphase growth; and bulk cathode degradation, including structural phase transitions, cation disorder, oxygen loss, and microstructural cracking. Drawing on advanced spectroscopy, microscopy, 3D imaging, and in situ/operando methods, each degradation cascade is traced from its diagnostic signature to its mechanism and to the validated mitigation it informed, from interfacial coatings to dopant engineering and microstructure optimization. Machine learning and artificial intelligence are assessed for interpreting complex diagnostic datasets and guiding predictive cathode design. The framework is further extended to practically relevant conditions (thick electrodes, low stack pressure, and large‐format cells), and the field's unresolved controversies are delineated together with the experiments that would decide them.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬전지용 층상 산화물 양극(NMC, NCA, LNO, 리튬과잉계)의 다중스케일 열화를 진단-메커니즘-완화(D-M-M) 프레임워크로 정리한 리뷰다. 계면 열화(화학적 분해, 공간전하층, 저항성 계면상)와 벌크 열화(상전이, 양이온 무질서, 산소 손실, 미세균열)를 다중 진단 기법으로 교차 검증했다. 머신러닝을 활용한 진단 데이터 해석과 예측형 양극 설계 가능성도 논의하며, 후막 전극·저압·대형셀 등 실제 조건으로 프레임워크를 확장했다.

papers.title: Interfacial Molecular Repulsion Engineering for Durable 5 V-Class Cobalt-Free Lithium-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The cobalt-free LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 (LNMO) cathode exhibits severe interfacial instability when employed with carbonate-based electrolytes. Here, we introduce methyl(3,3,3-trifluoropropyl)diethoxysilane (MFS) as a nonsacrificial additive that creates a molecular “repulsion layer” on LNMO. MFS preferentially adsorbs onto transition-metal sites, stabilizing the inner Helmholtz plane, suppressing solvent decomposition and HF attack, and forming a thin, mechanically robust cathode–electrolyte interphase. This unique interface design maintains fast Li+ transport while blocking parasitic reactions and transition-metal dissolution. With only 0.2 wt % MFS, Gr||LNMO full cells deliver 92% capacity retention after 450 cycles at 4.8 V under room temperature and 73% after 300 cycles at 45 °C. The potential practicality and universality of this strategy are demonstrated in 1.5 Ah Gr||LNMO pouch cells, as well as in cells incorporating lithium-rich layered oxide cathodes. This work establishes a molecular-level paradigm for advancing the development of cobalt-free battery chemistries.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트 프리 LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4(LNMO) 5V급 양극의 계면 불안정성을 해결하기 위해 비희생성 첨가제 MFS를 도입했다. MFS가 전이금속 자리에 흡착해 반발층을 형성함으로써 용매 분해와 HF 공격을 억제하고 얇고 견고한 계면상을 형성한다. 0.2wt% 첨가만으로 흑연||LNMO 풀셀은 상온 450사이클 후 92%, 45°C 300사이클 후 73%의 용량을 유지했으며, 1.5Ah 파우치셀 및 리튬과잉 양극 적용에서도 유효성을 확인했다.
